allies.rationale_text: Simplification helps complexity-bias-resistance strip away decorative detail as long as the causal core stays intact.
allies.source_quote: The disciplined commitment to simplicity and clarity.
allies.affinity_rationale: Core mechanism — 'The disciplined commitment to simplicity and clarity' — simplification IS the practical technique that CBR employs; CBR is the disposition and simplification is the execution.
allies.activation_condition: When analysis or communication has become more complex than the underlying problem requires and disciplined simplification is needed to strip away decorative detail while preserving the causal core

allies.rationale_text: Critical-thinking helps complexity-bias-resistance test whether a reduction preserves the real logic of the case instead of just sounding neat.
allies.source_quote: Ensuring decisions and communications are grounded in essential clarity.
allies.affinity_rationale: Validation discipline — 'Ensuring decisions and communications are grounded in essential clarity' — tests whether simplification preserves the real logic rather than producing a neat but misleading reduction.
allies.activation_condition: When a simplified model needs to be tested to verify that the reduction preserved the governing causal logic rather than producing a superficially clean but inaccurate story

antagonists.rationale_text: Curse-of-knowledge undermines complexity-bias-resistance by making experts instinctively jump to higher abstraction and methodological detail instead of the essential core the audience needs, defeating the simplification discipline CBR requires.
antagonists.source_quote: The chief antagonist. This bias makes it difficult for experts to communicate simply because they forget what it's like not to know.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Explicitly called 'the chief antagonist' — 'makes it difficult for experts to communicate simply because they forget what it is like not to know' — the primary force that defeats CBR's simplification discipline.
antagonists.activation_condition: When the expert's deep knowledge is causing them to communicate at higher abstraction levels or stress methodological details that the audience cannot process, defeating the simplification discipline

antagonists.rationale_text: Anchoring undermines complexity-bias-resistance by locking problem framing onto the first piece of information encountered, preventing recognition of a simpler and more accurate explanatory cut.
antagonists.source_quote: Focusing too heavily on the first piece of information or the initial problem framing (the 'anchor') can prevent the recognition of a simpler, better solution.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Frame-fixation — 'Focusing too heavily on the first piece of information or the initial problem framing prevents the recognition of a simpler, better solution' — locks analysis into the first frame rather than seeking the simplest accurate cut.
antagonists.activation_condition: When the initial problem framing is preventing recognition that a simpler and more accurate explanatory cut exists because attention is anchored to the first framework encountered

structured_tensions.tension_text: Complexity-bias-resistance conflicts with systems-thinking when insistence on simple explanations cuts off feedback loops and second-order effects that only emerge through system-level analysis.
structured_tensions.source_quote: complexity-bias-resistance conflicts with systems-thinking (systems thinking) when insistence on simple explanations cuts off feedback loops and second-order effects that only emerge through system-level analysis.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Complexity-bias-resistance conflicts with combinatorial-effects when resistance to complexity dismisses genuine multi-factor interactions as unnecessary elaboration.
structured_tensions.source_quote: complexity-bias-resistance conflicts with combinatorial-effects (combinatorial effects) when resistance to complexity dismisses genuine multi-factor interactions as unnecessary elaboration.

Antagonists: curse-of-knowledge 0.95 (critical — 'the chief antagonist'), anchoring 0.80 (moderate — frame fixation). Activation conditions assigned.
